sections.heading: How to Play Havoc
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Havoc"][color=c12]Havoc Demon Hunter Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]

Havoc Demon Hunter follows a priority list due to high-value cooldowns, while juggling Fury as a resource to spend as available. The core concepts to keep in mind in single target are these:


[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_demonhunter_chaosstrike size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Avoid Fury Waste:[/color][/b] In Single Target, [b]Fury[/b] is our primary resource used for spending on [spell=162794], while maintaining enough Fury to cast [spell=188499] when it comes off cooldown.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_demonhunter_bladedance size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Keep Abilities on Cooldown:[/color][/b] Cast abilities such as [spell=188499], [spell=258920], and [spell=198013] on cooldown, while spending Fury during downtime. 
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_demonhunter_vengefulretreat2 size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Maintain good Movement:[/color][/b] As [spell=198793] is part of the rotation, you need good control of your character to maintain Melee uptime to continue generating fury through [spell=203796].[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32740 icon=ability_demonhunter_specdps]Havoc Demon Hunter Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="Rotation Priority"][icon name=ability_demonhunter_specdps type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Best Havoc Demon Hunter Rotation[/h2]
For all forms of content, Havoc follows a priority list of what abilities to cast. Below, we break down the main priority lists for Havoc Demon Hunters: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.
[wrapper width=70%][box border=true]
[h3 type=bar toc=false]Hero Talent Master Switches[/h3]
[pad]
You can use the master switches below to flip the [b][i]entire page's[/i][/b] options to your selected choice. The current recommendation in Mythic+ is [symbol=wow-hero-talent-fel-scarred] [b][color=c10]Fel-Scarred[/color][/b], and in raid [symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] .

[center]
[wrapper width=620px]
[grid]
[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_ability_aldrachireaverdemonhunter_reaversglaive enable-options="AR-Op,AR-ST,AR-AOE" color=druid]Aldrachi Reaver[/display-group]
[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_ability_felscarreddemonhunter_demonsurge enable-options="FS-Op,FS-ST,FS-AOE" color=monk]Fel-Scarred[/display-group]
[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=misc_rnrredxbutton color=demon-hunter]Clear Selections[/display-group]
[/grid]

sections.heading: Single Target Priority

[pad]
Havoc in Single Target plays around a priority list, juggling short ability cooldowns before falling down to filler spenders. This means with each GCD we go top to bottom on a list, and press the button with the current highest value. [li icon=angle-double-right]At times in the rotation you will overcap [resource=17], this is [b]NOT[/b] an issue as long as you are following the priority list. Getting your cooldowns back on cooldown is simply more important than efficient Fury usage.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]Any unspent [spell=453323] empowerment's are lost if re-triggered via [spell=191427] or [spell=198013], be sure to spend them before pressing a button that will give more empowerments.[hr][/li]
[li display-options="FS-ST-In" icon=angle-double-right][spell=427640] causes you to use [spell=198793] tied closely to [spell=198013], both having a 20 second cooldown once [spell=258887] is stacked. [ul]
[li icon=angle-double-right][symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] plays heavily around [spell=442294], however with the changes to [spell=442686] in Midnight there is now no rotational changes to be made in Single Target, as you will have 100% uptime on the buff.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]At times in the rotation you will overcap [resource=17], this is [b]NOT[/b] an issue as long as you are following the priority list. Getting your cooldowns back on cooldown is simply more important than efficient Fury usage.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]When playing [spell=206476], [spell=198793] can be held for a few seconds to line up your [spell=388108] buff to a [spell=198013] or [spell=442718] as long as you will not drop your Exergy buff. Exergy can stack up to 30 seconds of duration, so every [spell=370965] cast will give you leeway to maintain Exergy.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]If there are add spawns, you should hold [spell=442294] to empower [spell=188499]. This will funnel significant damage into your priority target through [spell=442806]. The more targets you can hit, the more efficient your glaives will be.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]Your goal should be to maintain your [spell=442679] debuff on your primary target at all times, the stack count is only a 6% damage buff per stack; it will not multiply the damage of [spell=442806]. You cannot have [spell=442679] on multiple targets, it will replace any other mark when you swap targets.[hr][/li]

[li display-options="FS-ST-In" icon=angle-double-right][spell=427640] causes you to use [spell=198793] tied closely to [spell=198013], both having a 20 second cooldown once [spell=258887] is stacked. This is to overlap the 18% damage amp and [spell=388108] Critical Strike buffs onto [spell=198013] and the following [spell=453323] explosions.[hr][/li]
[/ul]

You will ALWAYS spend your empowerments in the order of [spell=162794] before [spell=188499] in 2+ targets, to maximize damage and increase your priority damage through Wounded Quarry. This is due to [spell=1272153] being such a significant buff to your Fury of the Aldrachi damage.

[ul]
[li icon=angle-double-right][symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] in AoE Scenarios (2+ targets) will always use your [spell=442294] empowerments on [spell=162794] first and [spell=188499] second. This gives you 12 [spell=442718] slashes, significantly increasing your AoE damage while also doing powerful Priority Target damage through funneling via [spell=442806]. [hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right][symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] plays heavily around [spell=442294], however with the changes to [spell=442686] in Midnight the rotational changes are minimal, as you will have 100% uptime on the buff.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]At times in the rotation you will overcap [resource=17], this is [b]NOT[/b] an issue as long as you are following the priority list. Getting your cooldowns back on cooldown is simply more important than efficient Fury usage.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right display-options="(AR-AOE-Ex)"]When playing [spell=206476], [spell=198793] can be held for a few seconds to line up your [spell=388108] buff to a [spell=198013] or [spell=442718] as long as you will not drop your Exergy buff. Exergy can stack up to 30 seconds of duration, so every [spell=370965] cast will give you leeway to maintain Exergy.[hr][/li]

[li icon=angle-double-right display-options="!(AR-AOE-Ex|AR-AOE-In)&(AR-AOE-Initiative)"]When [spell=388108] is your only 'movement' talent, you will use [spell=198793] to get [spell=388108] for your empowered [spell=188499]. You want to cast [spell=198793] a GCD or two [b]BEFORE[/b] [spell=188499] is ready to be pressed, to better position and have the [spell=388108] buff in advance.[hr][/li]

[li icon=angle-double-right]If there are add spawns, you should hold [spell=442294] to empower [spell=188499]. This will funnel significant damage into your priority target through [spell=442806]. The more targets you can hit, the more efficient your glaives will be.[hr][/li]
[li icon=angle-double-right]Your goal should be to maintain your [spell=442679] debuff on your primary target at all times, the stack count is only a 6% damage buff per stack it will not multiply the damage of [spell=442806]. You cannot have [spell=442679] on multiple targets, it will replace any other mark when you swap targets.[hr][/li]

sections.body:
[h2 toc=false type=bar]Pre-Combat Check[/h2]
Havoc Demon Hunter has no spec specific pre-combat steps to take due to our raid buff applying on attacking a mob. So I will simply list your consumables check!
[center][wrapper width=800px][box]
[ul]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Apply Weapon Oils -[/b] [color=q0][item=243734] on your main-hand and off-hand, this lasts 2 hours.[/color][/li]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Drink your Flask[/b] [color=q0]Use [item=241326] if it has fallen off, lasts 1-2 hours.[/color][/li]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Don't go Hungry[/b] [color=q0]Eat your [item=242275] every pull, or [item=242747] every hour.[/color][/li]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Augmentation[/b] (Optional) [color=q0]Use your [item=259085] for extra power.[/color][/li]
[/ul]
[/box][/wrapper][/center]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c12][icon name=ability_demonhunter_specdps type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Havoc Demon Hunter Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
For Havoc Demon Hunter, their cooldowns all interact with one another and have some specific utilization and ordering to use correctly as talked about below.

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Metamorphosis" icon=ability_demonhunter_metamorphasisdps]

[spell=191427] is not simply a press and go button due to the talent [spell=388112], which resets the cooldown of [spell=198013] and [spell=210152]. This means that a large portion of your burst damage will happen before [spell=191427] is cast, making it [b]extremely bad[/b] to macro trinkets directly into Meta. This also gives you a specific rotation to setup before casting, as the openers show.


[/tab]
[tab name="Eye Beam" icon=ability_demonhunter_eyebeam]
Due to [spell=213410], [spell=198013] provides a burst window where you are temporarily in Demon Form to make use of [spell=201427] and [spell=210152]. This typically means preparing before the window to get [spell=388108] up.

[/tab]
[tab name="Essence Break" icon=spell_shadow_ritualofsacrifice]
[spell=258860] is cast on cooldown due to [spell=1296612], except if [spell=198013] will be up within 4 seconds you hold and press it after.
[/tab]
[tab name="The Hunt" icon=inv_ability_demonhunter_thehunt]
[spell=370965] usage depends on your Hero Talent, for [symbol=wow-hero-talent-fel-scarred] [b][color=c10]Fel-Scarred[/color][/b] there is no talent interaction with your kit and it is simply pressed on cooldown for the damage it deals. [symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] has an important interaction with The Hunt, after the cast succeeds it will generate a [spell=442294] if you do not already have one. This means you must ALWAYS use a generated Reaver's Glaive in hand before casting The Hunt when it comes up, however you still will be looking to cast The Hunt on cooldown. The one caveat is due to [spell=1270898] only lasting 12 seconds, you should wait for Eye Beam to be up within 10 seconds before casting.
[/tab]
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c12][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Havoc Demon Hunter Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[pad]
[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Exergy" icon=ability_foundryraid_demolition]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c12] Inertia [/color][/h3]
	With [spell=206476], you will be lining up [spell=198793] consistently to [spell=198013]. This is due to [spell=389688] and [spell=258887] reducing both abilities to a 20 second cooldown, while using the damage amplification of [spell=388108] with the burst around Eye Beam for Fel-Scarred. If you make a mistake and de-sync, continue to use Eye Beam on cooldown and hold Vengeful Retreat for your next Eye Beam.

For Vengeful Retreat movement, you need to minimize downtime. This includes being as far as you can on one side of a mob, spinning around and using Vengeful through your target to stay in Melee range.
[/tab]

[tooltip name=OBR_with][color=q]Utilizing your cooldowns as they become available, timing them with other cooldowns, and overlapping properly.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=OBR_without][color=q]Following the Assisted Combat suggestions exactly, or only pressing the Single-Button without any other buttons being used.[/color][/tooltip]


[tooltip name=InertiaVR][color=q][spell=198793] should be pressed about a global before [spell=198013] comes off cooldown, followed by [spell=213241] or [spell=195072] to proc the damage amp.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=ExergyVR][color=q][spell=198793] should be pressed about a global before [spell=198013] comes off cooldown for [spell=388108].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=Essb][color=q]After casting [spell=258860] you should only be using [spell=210152] and [spell=201427] until the debuff falls.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=AbyssalGaze][color=q]This includes [spell=452497], the Fel-Scarred empowered version of [spell=198013] in [spell=191427].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-Ct][color=q][spell=198013] must be on cooldown and [spell=453323] empowerments on [spell=210152] and [spell=201427] spent.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-Afi][color=q][spell=258920] has 2 charges when talented into [spell=427775].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-Immo][color=q]This *always* includes [spell=452487], the Fel-Scarred empowered version of [spell=258920] in [spell=191427].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=Inertia-Hunt][color=q]Reminder casting [spell=370965] gives [spell=427640] when talented.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=EternalHunt][color=q][spell=1270898] causes your next [spell=198013] within 12 seconds to deal Double Damage.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=EssbHold][color=q] If [spell=198013] comes up within 4 seconds, hold Essence Break for after [spell=198013].[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=AR-Ct][color=q][spell=198013] must be on cooldown first.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=AR-Hunt][color=q][spell=370965] will only generate a [spell=442294] if you do not have one, you MUST spend a current [spell=442294] before casting. For Aldrachi, you will IGNORE [spell=1270898] damage amp entirely.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=AR-Rg][color=q][spell=442294] overwrites any unused empowerments, both [spell=162794] and [spell=188499] must be used before you cast again.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=AR-Felblade][color=q]As Aldrachi Reaver, [spell=232893] can also be used to pick up any [spell=178940] that are out of range to pick up manually. [spell=442502] will pick all souls up within 100 yd range on [spell=232893] cast.[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=FS-AOE-Ct][color=q][spell=198013] must be on cooldown and [spell=453323] empowerments on [spell=210152] and [spell=201427] spent. [spell=258920] must also have both charges used as [spell=452409] resets the cooldown.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-AOE-No-Ct][color=q][spell=258920] Must have both charges on cooldown as [spell=452409] will reset them.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=InitiativeVR][color=q][spell=198793] is exclusively used to get [spell=388108] for your empowered [spell=188499]. You want to cast [spell=198793] a GCD or two [b]BEFORE[/b] [spell=188499] is ready to be pressed.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=NotesHighlight][color=q]I'm an example note for more context![/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=FS-Op-In][color=q]This is to proc [spell=427640] before [spell=198793] overwrites it.[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=FS-Op-In2][color=q]This is to proc [spell=427640].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-Op-In-Meta][color=q][spell=198793] is off GCD and Metamorphosis cast slightly after it will cancel the movement.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=FS-Op-Afi][color=q][spell=452409] causes both charges of [spell=258920] to be reset when you cast [spell=191427].[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=FS-Op-AOE-Afi][color=q]This applies [spell=391189] before you cast [spell=258920].[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=AR-Op-Hunt][color=q]If you have a [spell=442294] up it must be thrown before pressing [spell=370965].[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=AR-Op-Afi][color=q]This assumes you have 2 charges up, if you will not overcap [spell=258920] skip this step.[/color][/tooltip]

[tooltip name=DoubleSweep][color=q][spell=1270901] causes your next Death Sweep to reset its own cooldown after Eye Beam. If you cancel your Eye Beam early this will not reset, and you skip the second sweep.[/color][/tooltip]
